architecture_contract.method: shared 64-dimensional feed-forward encoder trained semi-supervised on labeled scRNA expression and unlabeled scATAC gene-activity matrices, followed by a cell classifier and KNN label transfer
architecture_contract.training_stages: Stage 1 co-trains RNA and ATAC with classification and cross-modality embedding losses. Stage 3 re-trains using KNN pseudo-labels for ATAC.

implementation.checkpoint_policy: No checkpoint is admitted. A repository-bundled demonstration checkpoint exists but has no stated weight terms, is configuration-specific, and must not be fetched or loaded.

inductive_inference_contract.native_behavior: The official pipeline co-trains the encoder on every supplied RNA and ATAC dataset, creates ATAC pseudo-labels, and then retrains. It is transductive with respect to target cells.
inductive_inference_contract.required_if_terms_resolve: Implement a frozen encoder/head query path fit only on outer-training donors. Held cells may only be forwarded in eval/no-grad mode after all feature alignment and normalization are frozen.
inductive_inference_contract.forbidden: Do not include held or sealed cells in either training stage, KNN pseudo-label generation, feature intersection, normalization, checkpoint selection, or calibration.
inductive_inference_contract.sealed_modality_limit: The released transfer direction is labeled RNA to ATAC gene activity. GSE289173 is RNA-only, so its clean use is at most frozen RNA-encoder cell-state mapping, not the method's native target-modality experiment.

input_contract.atac: gene-activity matrix with exactly the same ordered genes as RNA; this is not a peak matrix
input_contract.pairing: RNA and ATAC cells need not be paired; the method treats modality datasets as separate populations
input_contract.reference: GENCODE v49 gene identifiers; any peak-to-gene activity construction must be frozen from outer-training data and declared
input_contract.rna: raw or normalized expression is accepted upstream without a single normative transform; benchmark preprocessing must therefore be specified and training-only

missingness_contract.model_semantics: The method ingests separate RNA and ATAC datasets and therefore tolerates dataset-level absent modalities without zero filling. It does not carry project missing-state masks.
missingness_contract.project_mapping: Preserve all project missingness states outside the model; construct no zero assay blocks.

output_contract.not_admitted: scJoint has no peak decoder and cannot emit an RNA-conditioned ATAC peak profile. Gene-activity embeddings or class probabilities are not accessibility profiles.

runtime_contract.declared: Developed with PyTorch 1.0.0 and reported tested with 1.0.0 and 1.4.0; exact Python and dependency locks are undeclared.

safe_loading_contract.reason: No code or checkpoint license was detected. Upstream uses unrestricted torch.load.
safe_loading_contract.future_requirement: Written permission plus CPU-first restricted inspection, exact hash/key/shape/dtype manifest, and safe local state-dict loading.

source_evidence: The exact repository tree and small public source text were inspected on 2026-08-22. No license file or repository license declaration was detected. No package was installed and no checkpoint was deserialized or executed.

task_fit.cell_state_mapping: Blocked until written code/checkpoint terms exist. If resolved, only a newly implemented frozen-query outer-fold wrapper is eligible.
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: Ineligible and latent-only: no peak decoder or peak-profile output.
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: Ineligible because the model has no sequence or allele-effect mechanism.
